title: Joy Barcoma calls out corruption in PH: 'Kinukuha niyo talaga lahat'
summary: Former Miss Earth Philippines Joy Barcoma has had enough of corruption in the country, saying that ordinary Filipinos should not be made to carry the burden of inefficiencies in government services.
